title: Build an HTTP Server in Rust
summary: Build a working web server from scratch in Rust using only the standard library: parse requests, route them, speak TCP and handle many clients at once.
description: Every website you have ever used is a program answering text messages over a network. In this track you will read those messages, parse them, build replies, wire it all to a real TCP socket and finally serve many clients at once — with nothing but Rust's standard library.
